source.community: runs\community-saves\Expedition33\mirror\<source>\ (one folder per source, data-only .sav files; manifest.json there: page, download URL, archive sha256 and the decoded state of every save) -> runs\save-sets\expedition33\community\<rung>\EXPEDITION_0.sav (the ladder file) + source\<original file name> (the same bytes); community\set.json lists each rung's sha256, source URL, archive path and decoded state. Rungs from it carry "community": true. Nexus archives not downloaded yet: pending_community; Nexus entries a mirror save stands in for: replaced_community.

target.backup: runs\save-backups\20261001-before-recipes\Expedition33-local (both SteamID folders; every .sav identical to today's except mopic_demo1's PlatformSaveData.sav, whose current copy is in runs\save-sets\expedition33\own\_index-acct1-20261002\)

install: run-test.ps1 -SaveFile copies the rung over slot 0 (EXPEDITION_0.sav in the logged-in account's folder, the recipe's save_slot), stamped with the current time; the slot-0 file before goes to <run>\save-before\, the game's copy after to <run>\save-after\. Nothing else is installed.

Community rungs install the same way: community\<rung>\EXPEDITION_0.sav is the community file byte for byte (no patch: an E33 save carries no SteamID, and the card comes from SavesContainer.sav), so it loads as slot 0 under mopic_demo1. postgame-ngplus2-worldmap's original is EXPEDITION_X.sav (source\), installed as EXPEDITION_0.sav like every rung.

Slot index: SavesContainer.sav lists slot 0 (EXPEDITION_0, card 야영지 / Camp, 2025-10-13 16:31, 16:21:31) and slot 1 (EXPEDITION_1, card 뤼미에르 / Lumiere, 2026-02-06 16:10, 00:01:02); slots 2-9 are empty (MainSave ""). A save in an empty slot is not listed (Nexus 149's author: create the slot first), so the rung goes to a listed slot. The card (place, date, party, playtime) comes from the container's MetaData, not from the .sav, so slot 0's card shows the previous save until the game saves; loading reads EXPEDITION_0.sav itself (community reports: a replaced EXPEDITION_N.sav loads under the old card). The container does not have to match, and the harness installs one file only.

Continue (계속하기) never loads directly: it opens the 게임 불러오기 list with the cursor on the first card. PlatformSaveData.LatestSaveGameLoaded does not move the cursor: during the discovery run of 2026-10-01 01:09 it was EXPEDITION_1 and the cursor was on slot 0 (runs\discover\e33\06.png), and F loaded EXPEDITION_0. The game rewrites PlatformSaveData on every load; leave it alone.

Why slot 0 and not slot 1: slot 0 is first in the list and under the cursor, so the proven route (Continue > F) loads it with no list navigation. Slot 1 (the 1-minute prologue save) would keep the user's 16 h slot 0 untouched, but needs a Down press and a checkpoint for 'second card selected' that cannot be recorded without the game. The user accepted overwriting own saves; slot 0's content stays in Backup\EXPEDITION_0_2025_10_13_7_31_29.sav (same spot, 16:21:13), in the backup above and in every run's save-before, and the last rung (camp-own-slot0) puts it back.

Order guard: the list showed slot 0 (2025-10-13) above slot 1 (2026-02-06), which is either slot order or oldest first. If it is oldest first, the first rung that autosaves slot 0 moves it below slot 1. The recipe's slot1_card_second checkpoint (slot 1's unchanging card in the second position) then fails the run (MENU_FAIL) instead of loading the prologue save.

Steam Cloud stays on (Auto-Cloud: WinAppDataLocal Sandfall/Saved/SaveGames/{64BitSteamID}, *.sav, recursive). At exit Steam uploads EXPEDITION_0.sav and whatever the game wrote (SavesContainer.sav, PlatformSaveData.sav, new Backup\EXPEDITION_0_<UTC>.sav autosaves). No conflict as long as no other PC plays E33 on mopic_demo1 meanwhile. mopic_demo2 is never logged in by the ladder; its files were only read.
notes: Own saves cover objectives 1, 2, 3, 7, 8, 9 and 10 (prologue to Old Lumiere). Community rungs add: objective 6 done (esquie-after-worldmap), the Visages Axon (renoir-after-camp, visages-plaza, visages-boss-before, visages-after-camp), after Sirene (sirene-after), the Act 3 open world (act3-meadows-flag, act3-frozen-hearts), the final dungeon and battle (final-dungeon-gardens, final-battle-in-progress), the Verso ending (ending-verso) and the Maelle-ending post-game (postgame-manor, postgame-monolith, postgame-reacher, postgame-ngplus2-worldmap). Still without a save: objectives 4-5 (Ancient Sanctuary, Gestral Village), the Act 2 opening, before Renoir, before Sirene, 13_EnterTheMonolith / 14_DefeatthePaintress at story time (postgame-monolith is inside the Monolith, but post-game), the exact Act 3 start and a New Game+ start: see pending_community.

Save builds: every own save CL 57661 (2025-10) except prologue-start (CL 61711, 2026-02). Community: CL 56180 (postgame-ngplus2-worldmap) and 56190 (esquie-after-worldmap), BP_SaveGameObject_V2; 56442 (final-dungeon-gardens, final-battle-in-progress, ending-verso), V3; 57069 (postgame-manor) and 57661 (renoir-after-camp .. act3-frozen-hearts), V4; 61582 (postgame-monolith, postgame-reacher), V6. The installed game is CL 68322 (about 1.5.6), newer than every rung; the game refuses only saves from a newer build, and the own camp save (CL 57661) has loaded in about ten harness runs, but no community save, and no V2/V3/V6 save, has been loaded on this build yet: expected to work, untested.

Rungs are autosaves at flags and area changes, so they start in exploration, mostly near a flag. camp-after-seacliff, camp-after-battlefield, renoir-after-camp and visages-after-camp are forced camps in progress and may open on a camp scene. prologue-start sits right after the prologue title. visages-boss-before (next to the boss arena), final-battle-in-progress (saved inside the final battle sequence) and postgame-monolith (the author levelled 89 -> 99 at that flag) may put a battle or a scene in the way: a battle ends the run in MENU_FAIL (no harm).

tier 1 (10 rungs, one per stage across the whole game): prologue-festival, meadows-landing, seacliff-start, worldmap, oldlumiere-arrival, visages-plaza, act3-meadows-flag, final-dungeon-gardens, postgame-manor, then camp-own-slot0, about 2 minutes of play each plus load and menus. tier 2: a second point per stage, the boss and ending points (flyingwaters-start, battlefield-gate and monoco-station moved here from tier 1 on 2026-10-02 to make room for Act 2-3 and the post-game). tier 3: optional side areas, extra camps, the Reacher and the NG+2 save. camp-own-slot0 is last on purpose (tier 1): it puts the user's slot 0 back, so the plain Expedition33 recipe plays the camp again afterwards. With -Only / -From that skip it, finish with -Only camp-own-slot0.
No loading-screen checkpoint yet: the recipe waits load_wait_s (40 s) after 확인. Record one on the first discovery run and switch to wait_gone, as Wukong-save does.
Per-rung vars: none yet; the recipe defaults are play_s 45 (two walking steps), look_s 20 (camera turns), load_wait_s 40.
